what: docs/524: EA mint handlers lifted to compiler templates (tools/emu/specs/mint_lift.py --write)
convention: esi = eval top, ebp = the interpreter frame ([ebp-8] invocation, [ebp-0xC] vt_sp, [ebp-0x10] runtime method, [ebp-0x14] locals); slots: imm = the operand at `operand` bytes from the instruction start, `size` bytes, ext zx/sx/mov into `reg`; next = the following instruction; taken = ip + 2 * the signed operand; exit = P0 exit to EA's handler (esi already put back); call = absolute target

brfalse.r8.reason: the handler advances ip by 4 bytes on the fall-through, the instruction is 6 bytes (EA bug, docs/213 §4): the compiler form would mis-place the next instruction

switch.reason: reads its case table through the ip with an index (P0 compiles switch as an exit)

stobj.vt.reason: the value size comes from a MonoClass lookup (0xE6F5A0): no class model in the frame

rem.r8.reason: calls the CRT _CIfmod (an x87 fprem loop this emulator does not model; docs/221 skips it too)
